extra.text: Wind changes the whole night route. Craft a personal thermometer and demonstrate a proper weather reading.
Your first verified completion counts as Lamplighters civic service. Joining the guild is optional.

accept.text: Bring the instrument unbroken, and keep it afterward for your own night rounds.

decline.text: Then trust your own weather sense and leave the instrument to another.

in_progress.text: One accurate instrument and your reading are enough.

ready.text: The line is steady and your reading agrees. That is proof enough.

extra.text: Keep the thermometer. Weather may surprise you, but it will not find you ignorant.
The Lamplighters will remember your service. Ask a guild contact about introductions and workshop commissions.
